class.description: XREyeEffectResource Declarative `GameplayResource` driving stereoscopic per-eye shader parameters via `Spline1DResource` (float tracks such as `eye_open`, `eye_feather`, `override`) and `Spline4DResource` (4-channel RGBA/HSVA color tracks such as `color`, `override_color`, `eye_closed_color`). Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
